lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal and vertical rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of bright blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high pixel intensity above to a shadowed gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots across the visible surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger grid-patterned blobs on the torso.
